Maya (Design): Quick UX check: when a modal closes we show a success toast. Observed it sometimes overlaps modal footer CTAs during rapid flows. Screenshot in thread.
Ethan (Frontend): Repro: open integration modal -> save -> modal closes -> toast appears bottom-left and covers the "Add another" button for ~300ms. Keyboard users can't tab to it while covered.
Priya (a11y): Two concerns: visual overlap (hit target blocked) and screen reader interruptions. Suggestion: default to not stealing focus for success toasts; use `role=status` + `aria-live=polite`. For toasts that relate to modal action, append toast id to modal `aria-describedby`.
Zoe (Product): Prefer not moving focus in happy path. But can't have CTAs blocked. Can we add a placement rule: avoid modal bounding boxes and maintain min gap token (12px)?
Ethan (Frontend): Plan: 1) generate unique ids per toast (`toast-<ts>`), 2) place toasts with a simple geometry check to avoid visible modal rects, 3) when modal present set `aria-hidden=true` on decorative toasts and add description to modal if message is relevant.
Priya (a11y): Also: errors should be assertive (`role=alert`) and shift focus to first invalid control. Success = polite.
Maya (Design): Visual tweak: remove pointer/chevron from toasts so corner flips look consistent. Update spacing token to enforce min gap 12px in compact mode.
ci-bot: New PR opened: frontend#2456 - "toast: modal-aware placement + a11y fixes"
Ethan (Frontend): I'll add a small Cypress e2e to check toast doesn't overlap CTA and tag @Priya for accessibility review. ETA: tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
